angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 501,600 km at 102.70 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.7367 +/- 0.0113 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 102.70 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.721 +/- 0.053 solar radii from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1244 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract): 501,600 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.73 +/- 0.09 solar masses from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1244 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4599 +/- 123 K from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1244 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1244 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1244.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.586, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1244 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.034 dex, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1244 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.62893, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1244 (pscomppars): age 5.9 Gyr, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, TOI-1244: projected rotation speed 1.5 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2022ApJS..259...35A)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
